presentation.finalHeldoutParagraph: The closed 96-run heldout export records 1213 local model dispatches: 1213 actor calls and 0 auxiliary goal/candidate calls. It records 809 opportunity rejections across 809 prefetch-arm checkpoints. Every recorded prefetch checkpoint returned at the original perfect-predictor opportunity gate before memory retrieval, goal inference or ranking. The native arms were nominal configurations executing demand-only actor behavior; these outcomes do not measure auxiliary-predictor efficacy. No cohort configured episodic embeddings/vector retrieval. The original timing-validity flags, failures, censoring and constraint-audit unknowns remain unchanged. Recorded timing-invalidity sample reason codes: host_guard_not_configured.
